name: Smart_Bank spot-ratio SBT price for loans
summary: Smart_Bank prices SBT as the spot ratio of its own USDT and SBT balances, both for Buy_SBT and for the collateral Loan_Get requires, and anyone may call _Start once it holds 1M USDT. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker topped the bank up past 1M, started it, bought 20M SBT from it, which raised the ratio about 40-fold, then borrowed 1,966,930 USDT against 1.3M SBT valued at that ratio.
notes: Loss is the bank's net USDT outflow (57,455 USDT held before, 9.96 after). The 18.7M SBT the attacker kept has no market and was never moved, so it realised nothing (rule 12).
The bank had never been started: an operator _Start() call at block 40309845 reverted, and later operator calls only changed counters.
